title: Complement Pairs I Know by Heart
objective: Retrieve complements to 10 quickly, without rebuilding a ten-frame every time — fluency practice after the concept (1.2.3) is secure.
studentQuestion: Can you answer without the frame this time?

teaching.see: What does this number need to make 10?
teaching.break: Retrieve from memory first; fall back to the ten-frame only if stuck.
teaching.build: Answer, then move to the next.
teaching.transform: This lesson intentionally does not add a new equivalence; it drills the one already established in 1.2.3.

check.prompt: Self-check against a ten-frame for any answer given with hesitation.

examples.second: The same run, repeated, for personal improvement.
examples.transfer: Complements given out of numeric order (e.g., 6, 2, 9, 4) to confirm retrieval, not a memorized sequence.

mastery.evidence: Answers at least 7 of 9 out-of-order complement prompts within a few seconds each, without rebuilding a frame.
